description: This file implements RADIUS server functionality for hostapd, including TLS event handling, user data management, configuration loading, and server setup.

methods.name: radius_tls_event
methods.description: Handles TLS events such as certificate verification, alerts, and peer certificate info during TLS communication.

methods.name: radius_userdata_init
methods.description: Initializes radius_user_data structure, setting up kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with radius_user_data, including kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_load
methods.description: Loads user data from JSON file into radius_user_data structure.

methods.name: load_userfile
methods.description: Loads and updates user data from specified user file if modified.

methods.name: radius_user_get
methods.description: Retrieves user attribute data by username, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: radius_parse_attr
methods.description: Parses RADIUS attribute data from blob message.

methods.name: radius_count_attrs
methods.description: Counts attributes and total size needed for RADIUS attributes based on user data.

methods.name: radius_add_attr
methods.description: Adds a RADIUS attribute to the buffer, handling vendor-specific attributes.

methods.name: radius_parse_attrs
methods.description: Parses and adds RADIUS attributes from user data blobs.

methods.name: radius_user_parse_methods
methods.description: Parses EAP methods from user data and updates EAP user structure.

methods.name: radius_user_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves or creates EAP user state for a given username.

methods.name: radius_get_eap_user
methods.description: Callback to retrieve EAP user info based on identity, supporting phase 1 and phase 2.

methods.name: radius_setup
methods.description: Initializes the radius server with TLS and EAP configurations.

methods.name: radius_init
methods.description: Initializes radius server state and user data structures.

methods.name: radius_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes and frees radius server resources.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the radius main program.

methods.name: radius_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the radius server program, handling command-line options, setup, and event loop.
